description: This package contains Microsoft Azure SDK for StorageCache Management SDK. For documentation on how to use this package, please see https://aka.ms/azsdk/java/mgmt. A Storage Cache provides scalable caching service for NAS clients, serving data from either NFSv3 or Blob at-rest storage (referred to as "Storage Targets"). These operations allow you to manage Caches. Package api-version 2026-08-01.
